notes.title: Quality of Life Changes
notes.content:
Change log QoL
[list]
[*] Added a button to move all items left on the Dirty Dish Board
[*] Right-click on an item while it's not clean to move it to the other board
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Items now give the correct amount of Golden Bubbles
[/list]

Thank you, wroch and Seb, for your feedback, which led to implementing these changes! :)
